apps.name: Waypoint
apps.localizedDescription: Personal location planning, timed holds and continuous area walking.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a no-location Wi-Fi/cellular connection check. Includes continuous area walking, a scrolling options panel, and corrected Light/Dark appearance. Cellular startup and restoration remain unreliable. Stop and restore before updating the existing app. Free signing still needs weekly refresh.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect to this iPhone's developer service through its local VPN.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keep your explicitly started location session running in the background until you stop it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Keep your explicitly started location session running when you leave Waypoint.
